name: zvideo_fxpass3_slot_set_rect_and_payload
description: zVideoFxPass3Slot::SetRectAndPayload positions a local FxPass3 slot and stores its radial-warp payload.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; defer to a zVideo FxPass3 UI-element/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4bdc00 validates the thiscall slot ABI, HudUiElement SetPos dispatch through vtable slot 0x0c, and stores to currentRadius, maxRadius, extent, sinFreq, and sinPhase at slot offsets 0x38..0x48.
The native FxPass3 smoke routes the slot through the common HudUiElement vtable, verifies x/y position updates through SetPos, and verifies all radial-warp payload fields.
